descriptionChirho: The proper feminine place name Edrei (Hebrew אֶדְרֶעִי), a city in Bashan where Israel defeated King Og (Numbers 21:33; Deuteronomy 1:4, 3:1, 10), also listed among Naphtali's cities (Joshua 19:37). All 8 occurrences refer to the same geographic location with only prepositional/conjunctional variation. Translations are uniform: eng 'Edrei', spa 'Edrei', hin एद्रई / एद्रेई, arb إذْرَعي / إِدْرَعِي, kor 에드레이, swa 'Edrei'. Both clusters represent the same toponym in different syntactic frames.
